summary: E-commerce/order flow project with admin account management, VIP pricing discount, product option selection (height), and storefront messaging (delivery time).

existing_features.title: Make VIP status work end-to-end by ensuring the frontend VIP check reflects the same VIP source of truth that admins toggle in the backend (so a VIP user consistently receives the VIP experience and pricing).
Apply a 10% VIP discount to order pricing everywhere the user sees pricing for a new order (including the order pricing breakdown and the final total), using the existing VIP pricing logic.
Change the height input on the new order form to a dropdown (select) for height selection.
Add a visible “2–3 week Delivery time” message on the main (landing) page.
Fix any broken VIP- and order-related flows introduced by the above changes so that creating an order, viewing pricing, and toggling VIP as an admin work without runtime errors.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement VIP customer discount: apply 10% off order pricing when user is marked VIP.
Add a height selection dropdown (instead of freeform height input).
Display a '2–3 week delivery time' message on the main page.

projectName: Fix VIP 10% discount, add height dropdown, and show delivery-time message on landing page
